items.source: Implementations of this interface can be provided to AbstractMockHttpServletRequestBuilder.with(RequestPostProcessor) at the time when a request is about to be constructed.
items.translation: 此接口的实现可以在即将构建请求时提供给AbstractMockHttpServletRequestBuilder.with(RequestPostProcessor)。

items.source: Post-process the given MockHttpServletRequest after its creation and initialization through a MockHttpServletRequestBuilder.
items.translation: 在通过 MockHttpServletRequestBuilder 创建和初始化 MockHttpServletRequest 之后，对其进行后处理。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: the request to use, either the one passed in or a wrapped one
items.translation: 使用传入的请求或包装后的请求。
